action_map.rule: {'POST':'create','PATCH':'update','PUT':'update','DELETE':'delete'}.get(action, action) — unknown verbs pass through unchanged

notes: is_active flip is a filtered UPDATE (no save(); updated_at untouched by the task).
Email task looked up by the same ids; its own broad except swallows lookup failures.

deactivation_email_task.broad_except: log_exception(e, warning=True) + logger.error; send failures never propagate
deactivation_email_task.connection: get_connection(host, int(port), username, password, use_tls=(EMAIL_USE_TLS == '1'), use_ssl=(EMAIL_USE_SSL == '1')) — string '1' comparison, port coerced with int()
deactivation_email_task.email_config: get_email_configuration() -> (EMAIL_HOST, EMAIL_HOST_USER, EMAIL_HOST_PASSWORD, EMAIL_PORT, EMAIL_USE_TLS, EMAIL_USE_SSL, EMAIL_FROM)
deactivation_email_task.message: f'Webhook {webhook.url} has been deactivated due to failed requests.'
deactivation_email_task.subject: Webhook Deactivated
deactivation_email_task.template: emails/notifications/webhook-deactivate.html -> render_to_string, then generate_plain_text_from_html for the text part

headers.X-Pi Dash-Signature: <hmac hex, ONLY when webhook.secret_key is truthy>

hmac.quirk_port_as_is: signature is computed over json.dumps(payload) with DEFAULT separators (', ', ': '), not over the wire bytes requests sends for json=payload. The sample hex above pins that exact input.

lookup: Webhook.objects.get(id=webhook_id, workspace__slug=slug); ANY exception (DoesNotExist included) -> log_exception + logger.error + return (no send, no retry)

result_rows.failure_log: save_webhook_log(response_status=500 as INT, response_headers='', response_body=str(e), retry_count=self.request.retries)
result_rows.success_log: save_webhook_log(request_method=<mapped action>, request_headers=<headers dict>, request_body=<payload dict>, response_status=response.status_code, response_headers=response.headers, response_body=response.text, retry_count=self.request.retries)

retry.count: retry_count comes from self.request.retries at log time
retry.not_reached: raise requests.RequestException() — BARE constructor, original error discarded; celery autoretries
retry.outer_except: any non-RequestException after the send block -> log_exception + return (no retry)
